ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the efforts being made to prevent it.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
What efforts are being made to prevent fraud?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant fraud and abuse. By analyzing data and public records, we may be able to identify patterns and trends that can inform efforts to prevent fraud.
